sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT s.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
WHERE STR_TO_DATE(s.date_positive_hiv_test_confirmed, '%Y-%m-%d')
      BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND (
      s.transfer_in_regimen IS NULL
      OR TRIM(s.transfer_in_regimen) = ''
  );
